_comment: Touch ID and Windows Hello prompt wording, in Italian (each completes the system's own sentence, so it starts with a verb), shared by internal/vault/approval_prompt_test.go (Go, every OS) and cmd/pvault/touchid_prompt_test.go (the Swift helper), so the two can never word a prompt differently. vault is the vault folder name (default .pvault); a grant without scope asks for full access; access defaults to read and ttl to 120 seconds.
